tested_commit_semantics: Exact task tests ran against the committed implementation at this code commit.
decision_resolution: Added held-out paired-family admission and revocation boundary checks. Passing software fixtures do not imply device execution or scientific admission.
positive_checks: All subject families and paired evidence within policy gates admit the declared capability identity.
negative_checks: Missing family, changed implementation fingerprint, or winner-only disagreement prevents admission.
limitations: Software and synthetic fixture verification only; no physical admission or installation authority.
